text: 国务院办公厅日前印发《关于适应人工智能技术发展助力构建就业友好型发展方式的意见》，对相关工作作出部署。
text_en: The General Office of the State Council recently issued the Opinions on Adapting to the Development of Artificial Intelligence Technology and Helping Build an Employment-Friendly Development Model, making arrangements for related work.
